name: MonarchColumnChooser
title: ColumnChooser
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn of MonarchSwitchRow (androidx.compose.material3.Switch); MonarchReorderableList for reordering; MonarchSearchBar (androidx.compose.material3.DockedSearchBar) for the search
summary: A panel to show, hide, find and reorder the columns of a table, for a sheet, a settings screen or a saved-view editor.
whenToUse: When people choose which columns of a MonarchDataTable they see and in what order, usually in a ModalBottomSheet opened from a Columns button.
whenNotToUse: For a quick show and hide from a toolbar without ordering, use the column-menu recipe (a DropdownMenu with checkboxes). For reordering other things use MonarchReorderableList.
api: @Composable public fun MonarchColumnChooser(columns: List<MonarchColumnChooserColumn>, hiddenColumns: Set<String>, onHiddenColumnsChange: (Set<String>) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, order: List<String> = emptyList(), onOrderChange: ((List<String>) -> Unit)? = null, searchThreshold: Int = DefaultSearchThreshold, minimumVisible: Int = 1, onReset: (() -> Unit)? = null, searchIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, clearIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchColumnChooserLabels = MonarchColumnChooserLabels())
public class MonarchColumnChooserColumn(label: String, id: String = label, hideable: Boolean = true)

public class MonarchColumnChooserLabels(title: String? = null, shownCount: ((shown: Int, total: Int) -> String)? = null, search: String? = null, noMatches: String? = null, required: String? = null, showAll: String? = null, reset: String? = null, clearSearch: String? = null, handle: ((label: String) -> String)? = null, moved: ((label: String, position: Int, total: Int) -> String)? = null)

options.name: columns
options.description: The columns in their default order. MonarchDataTableColumn.chooserColumn gives one.

options.name: hiddenColumns
options.description: The ids of hidden columns, the same set MonarchDataTable takes.

options.name: onHiddenColumnsChange
options.description: Called with the whole new hidden set when a switch or Show all is used.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the panel. Give it a bounded height inside a vertically scrolling parent.

options.name: order
options.description: Column ids in display order; ids missing from it follow in their default order.

options.name: onOrderChange
options.description: Called with the whole new order after each move. With it, rows reorder by long-press drag and by the handle's Move up and Move down actions.

options.name: searchThreshold
options.description: Offers the search field from this many columns. Int.MAX_VALUE never offers it.

options.name: minimumVisible
options.description: The fewest columns that must stay shown; the last ones cannot be switched off.

options.name: onReset
options.description: Adds a Reset button that runs this, to restore the app's default columns.

options.name: searchIcon
options.description: An icon at the start of the search field.

options.name: clearIcon
options.description: The icon of the search field's clear button; the button is shown only with it.

states.name: default
states.description: A switch per column, on when it is shown, with "5 of 8 shown" under the title.

states.name: required column
states.description: Always on and disabled, with "Always shown" under its name.

states.name: minimum reached
states.description: The switches of the last shown columns are disabled.

states.name: reorderable
states.description: With onOrderChange each row starts with a drag handle; a long press drags the row.

states.name: searching
states.description: Only matching columns are listed, reordering is off, and "No columns match." is shown when nothing matches.

states.name: some hidden
states.description: A Show all button appears under the list.

appearance: The title in the subheading style with the count in muted caption text under it; rows are MonarchSwitchRow in Monarch colors, and reorderable rows have the surface fill and subtle border of MonarchReorderableList. Every color is a theme role, so dark and both high-contrast themes follow the theme.
platformNotes: The web panel uses checkboxes and Move up and Move down icon buttons; Android uses the platform switch, as iOS does, and reorders with MonarchReorderableList: a long press drags a row, and the row's handle offers Move up and Move down to TalkBack, Switch Access and the arrow keys. There are no visible move buttons. The web takes a visibility record; Android takes the set of hidden ids, like iOS. The web headingLevel has no equivalent; the title and count are one heading. The list is lazy, so the panel needs a bounded height inside a scrolling parent. The labels name the drag handle ("Reorder Status") instead of iOS's moveUp and moveDown, because the Move up and Move down actions belong to the handle.
accessibility: The title and count are read together as one heading: "Columns, 5 of 8 shown".
Each column is one switch row read with its name, its note and its state.
Columns that cannot be hidden and the last shown columns are disabled switches.

With onOrderChange each row has a drag handle named "Reorder Status" with the actions Move up and Move down, and every move is announced through a polite live region: "Status moved to position 1 of 3."
Rows, Show all and Reset have 48dp touch targets; names wrap at font scale 2.0; the handle comes before the name in both reading directions.
edgeCases: A column id in hiddenColumns that cannot be hidden is still shown.
Ids in order that are not columns are ignored.
While the search filters, rows cannot move; clear the search to reorder.
minimumVisible larger than the number of columns disables every shown switch.

examples.title: Next to a DataTable
examples.template:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp)) {
    MonarchColumnChooser(
        columns = columns.map { it.chooserColumn },
        hiddenColumns = hidden,
        onHiddenColumnsChange = { hidden = it },
        order = order,
        onOrderChange = { order = it },
        chevrons = true,
        onReset = {
            hidden = setOf({{hidden.0}})
            order = emptyList()
        },
    )
    MonarchDataTable(
        caption = {{caption}},
        rows = records,
        columns = columns,
        rowKey = { it[0] },
        hiddenColumns = hidden,
        columnOrder = order,
        layout = MonarchDataTableLayout.Table,
    )
}
examples.setupTemplate:
val records = listOf(
    listOf({{rows.0.id}}, {{rows.0.name}}, {{rows.0.status}}, {{rows.0.owner}}, {{rows.0.region}}, {{rows.0.renews}}),
    listOf({{rows.1.id}}, {{rows.1.name}}, {{rows.1.status}}, {{rows.1.owner}}, {{rows.1.region}}, {{rows.1.renews}}),
    listOf({{rows.2.id}}, {{rows.2.name}}, {{rows.2.status}}, {{rows.2.owner}}, {{rows.2.region}}, {{rows.2.renews}}),
)
val columns = listOf<MonarchDataTableColumn<List<String>>>(
    MonarchDataTableColumn({{columns.0.header}}, id = {{columns.0.id}}, hideable = {{columns.0.hideable}}) { it[1] },
    MonarchDataTableColumn({{columns.1.header}}, id = {{columns.1.id}}) { it[2] },
    MonarchDataTableColumn({{columns.2.header}}, id = {{columns.2.id}}) { it[3] },
    MonarchDataTableColumn({{columns.3.header}}, id = {{columns.3.id}}) { it[4] },
    MonarchDataTableColumn({{columns.4.header}}, id = {{columns.4.id}}) { it[5] },
)
var hidden by remember { mutableStateOf(setOf({{hidden.0}})) }
var order by remember { mutableStateOf(emptyList<String>()) }
examples.setup:
val records = listOf(
    listOf("1", "Alpha", "Active", "Sam Lee", "EU", "2027-02-01"),
    listOf("2", "Bravo", "Paused", "Ana Ruiz", "US", "2026-11-30"),
    listOf("3", "Charlie", "Active", "Kim Park", "APAC", "2027-06-15"),
)
val columns = listOf<MonarchDataTableColumn<List<String>>>(
    MonarchDataTableColumn("Name", id = "name", hideable = false) { it[1] },
    MonarchDataTableColumn("Status", id = "status") { it[2] },
    MonarchDataTableColumn("Owner", id = "owner") { it[3] },
    MonarchDataTableColumn("Region", id = "region") { it[4] },
    MonarchDataTableColumn("Renews", id = "renews") { it[5] },
)
var hidden by remember { mutableStateOf(setOf("region")) }
var order by remember { mutableStateOf(emptyList<String>()) }

        columns = columns.map { it.chooserColumn },

        onHiddenColumnsChange = { hidden = it },
        order = order,
        onOrderChange = { order = it },

        onReset = {
            hidden = setOf("region")
            order = emptyList()
        },

    MonarchDataTable(
        caption = "Records",
